newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: RUGBY UNION-SOUTH AFRICA DROPS STRANSKY FOR THIRD TEST.
newsitem.headline: RUGBY UNION-SOUTH AFRICA DROPS STRANSKY FOR THIRD TEST.

text.p: South Africa dropped flyhalf Joel Stransky on Tuesday when they announced their team in Johannesburg for the third and final test against New Zealand at Ellis Park on Saturday.
Stransky's exclusion was one of five changes made by the Springbok selectors as they attempt to salvage some pride against the All Blacks having already lost the series, 2-0.

Henry Honiball replaces Stransky -- who was the Springbok hero a month ago when he scored all 25 points in a win over Australia -- with Japie Mulder returning from a back injury in place of Andre Snyman.
Three changes are forced by injury in the forwards with lock Kobus Wiese, hooker James Dalton and prop Dawie Theron replacing the trio of Hannes Strydom, Henry Tromp and Os du Randt.

15-Andre Joubert, 14-Justin Swart, 13-Japie Mulder, 12-Danie van Schalkwyk, 11-Pieter Hendriks; 10-Henry Honiball, 9-Joost van der Westhuizen; 8-Gary Teichmann (captain), 7-Andre Venter, 6-Ruben Kruger, 5-Mark Andrews, 4-Kobus Wiese, 3-Marius Hurter, -James Dalton, 1-Dawie Theron.
